questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At vælge et internationalt anerkendt universitet, hvor jeg vidste, at jeg kunne blive udfordret akademisk (og helst et sted, hvor de talte engelsk).

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Man modtager en milliard mails med information, så man føler sig ikke tabt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Man bliver modtaget i sin hall of residence af dit Warden Team, som hjælper alle med at komme på plads og finde værelse osv. Der er også IT-hjælp, så man kan komme på wifi.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der findes flere forskellige halls of residence, som ligger spredt ud i byen. På den måde er de alle sammen "on campus", da hele byen på sin vis omhandler uni, men jeg endte fx med at bo omkring 25 minutters gang fra mine undervisningslokaler, mens jeg havde boet meget tættere på som medicin- eller kemistuderende. Man bliver tildelt en hall alt efter hvilken leveform, man har prioriteret. Man kan vælge mellem enkelt- eller deleværelser, eget eller delt bad og catered eller non-catered. Der er forskellige halls til de forskellige måder at bo på.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Hvis man vælger at være catered, så får man serveret tre måltider om dagen i hverdagen og morgenmad og frokost i weekenden. Derudover har ens gang et delekøkken, men fair warning man skal selv ud og købe gryder og pander, så jeg brugte det meget sjældent.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Gør det! Det kan virke som en dyr beslutning at bo i halls, men det er virkelig pengene værd, da man møder så mange venner i dining hall'en og til hall arrangementer osv.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Alle udvekslingsstuderende får tildelt et tidsrum, hvor de skal møde op i en bygning for at få personlig akademisk vejledning af en institut-repræsentant. Man taler om, hvilke fag man før har haft, og hvilke man kunne tænke sig at prøve nu. Man bliver rådet ift. hvad de tror, at man kan finde ud af osv. Ankom til vejledning med en idé om hvilke fag, du gerne vil prøve - gerne flere, end du faktisk kan tage.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: One-on-one vejledning

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle fag, som jeg havde ønsket.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det faglige niveau - i hvert fald på SAMF - er meget det samme som på KU, så vær ikke bange for at tage fag på højere niveau. Fag tiltænkt første- og andenårsstuderende har ofte meget undervisning, store klasser og mange lektier, mens fagene på honours niveau kun mødes 1-2 gange om ugen, og man har meget mere personlig kontakt med sin professor.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Samme som på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget det samme på KU med forelæsning og derefter holdundervisning.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Anthropology of Epidemics & Geographies of Race, Racialisation and Racism

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Anthropology of Epidemics er noget nær det bedste antro-kursus jeg nogensinde har taget! Christos er den sødeste ever, og han har enormt meget viden, som han elsker at dele. Man efterlader hver time helt beæret over at blive undervist af en ægte ekspert i feltet.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Sport på uni er meget dyrt :(

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Offentlig transport er overraskende billig og der kører bussen i stort set hele landet

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Så mange klubber og societies! Alt fra akademiske fællesskaber, politiske klubber, niche interesserer til alle tænkelige sportsgrene.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Bliv medlem i Breakaway, som er en hill-walking society. Så kan man komme på fede vandreture rundt omkring i Skotland :)

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag til Glasgow! Super fed by med skønne mennesker og et fedt kulturliv. Det tager omkring to timer med toget.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Pubs gør det nemt at blive venner med de fleste ;)

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Tal med så mange som muligt - alle er alligevel nye, så de vil gerne møde dig!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Amerikanere (og dem er der mange af) råber MEGET, når de taler.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Pubs :). St. Andrews har en rigtig god pub scene

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Lav så meget, som du overhovedet kan overskue
2. Kom udenfor - det kan godt være, at Skotland har ry for elendigt vejr, men det er altså ikke værre end KBH
3. Tal med alle på din vej

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At møde mennesker fra hele verden

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At savne sit liv i KBH

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
